faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Ground Helper recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the PAU Ground Helper recruitment is 15th October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Ground Helper post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Ground Helper post is Middle standard with Punjabi language proficiency. Candidates must have passed at least the Middle standard examination.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Ground Helper position at PAU?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Ground Helper position is between 18 years and 58 years. Candidates must fall within this age bracket to be eligible for the recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Ground Helper post at Punjab Agricultural University?
faq.answer: Applications for the Ground Helper post are to be submitted offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website and send it along with required documents via post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Ground Helper post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Ground Helper post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 13,486 to Rs. 14,286 per month, with an additional Rs. 800 per month fixed.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for the Ground Helper post?
faq.answer: As per the notification, there is one vacancy for the post of Ground Helper at Punjab Agricultural University.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for the PAU Ground Helper recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 118/- (including GST). SC/ST category candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection criteria for the Ground Helper position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Ground Helper position includes a Practical Test followed by Document Verification. Candidates must perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Punjab Agricultural University, which is pau.edu.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age relaxation for reserved categories. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for detailed information regarding age relaxation policies.
